programme.title: Jõmpsikad Pariisis
programme.desc: Pariisis puhkusel olles aitavad Jõmpsikad Chuckie'l uut ema otsida, samal ajal takistades tema isa abiellumast riukaliku ärinaisega.

programme.title: Seersant Bilko
programme.desc: Tõeline intrigant seersant Bilko on oma koloneli täiesti ümber oma sõrme keeranud: ta teatab, et katsetab uutmoodi tanki ehitamist, tegelikult aga tegeleb kaartide ja teiste hasartmängudega. 1996

programme.title: Ananassiekspress
programme.desc: Eluheidikust narkomaan on ainus tunnistaja mõrvale, mille sooritavad narkoparun ja korrumpeerunud politseinik. See tähendab surmaotsust ja mees põgeneb elu eest, võttes kaasa oma diileri ja varustaja.

programme.title: Vana kool
programme.desc: Kolm sõpra püüavad taas ellu äratada oma nooruse parimad päevad, asutades oma kunagise ülikooli läheduses korporatsiooni.

programme.title: Rambow poeg
programme.desc: 1980ndate alguse Inglismaa pikk suvi. Kaks erineva taustaga koolipoissi hakkavad tegema filmi, mis on inspireeritud Sylvester Stallone'i filmist 'First Blood'.

programme.title: Ratastel Las Vegasesse
programme.desc: Veidrikust ajakirjanik ja tema psühhopaadist jurist reisivad Las Vegasesse, ajades taga erinevaid psühhedeelilisi kogemusi.

programme.title: The Disobedient
programme.desc: As children, Leni and Lazar were best friends. At Lazar's father's funeral, Leni yearns to reconnect with her friend but still feels the sting of their years of estrangement.

programme.title: Mozart and the Whale
programme.desc: A love story between two savants with Asperger's syndrome, a kind of autism whose effects sabotage their budding relationship.

programme.title: The Painted Veil
programme.desc: A doctor gets married to a beautiful woman but soon finds out that she is cheating on him; battling his way through problems, he heads to China to fight a dreaded disease spread in a small village.

programme.title: L'homme debout
programme.desc: Clémence must secure her job by forcing Henri, a wallpaper salesman, into early retirement, but his refusal sparks an unexpected bond that drives them to their breaking point.

programme.title: Les femmes du square
programme.desc: Angèle, a young Ivorian woman, has always got by thanks to her courage. To avoid reprisals from a gang of thugs, she manages to get hired as a nanny for an 8-year-old boy from an upscale neighborhood.

programme.title: Days of the Bagnold Summer
programme.desc: A teenager spends his summer listening to heavy metal music and trying to get along with his librarian mum.

programme.title: Boutchou
programme.desc: When a happy young couple welcome their first child, their four new grandparents start vying for exclusive control of the baby in a rivalry that spirals out of control.

programme.title: Death on the Nile
programme.desc: Hercule Poirot enjoys a luxurious cruise down the Nile - when a newlywed heiress is found murdered on board, can Poirot identify the killer before the ship reaches the end of its journey?

programme.title: Plancha
programme.desc: To celebrate Yves' 50th birthday, his friends plan to take him to Paros in Greece; due to a flight cancellation, they're on their way to a much rainier destination: Yves' family home in Brittany.

programme.title: The Measure of a Man (2015)
programme.desc: At the age of 51 and after 20 months of unemployment, Thierry starts a new job that soon brings him face to face with a moral dilemma. How much is he willing to accept to keep his job?

programme.title: Rookie
programme.desc: This is a story of lost dreams and second chances that is steeped in engine oil and the adrenaline of motorcycle racing.

programme.title: Pink Lady (2023)
programme.desc: Bati and Lazer, a Haredi Jerusalem couple, face a crisis when Lazer is blackmailed over a secret affair with his male study partner. A painful journey tests their love and faith.

programme.title: Memphis
programme.desc: A strange singer with God-given talent drifts through his adopted city of Memphis. His journey quickly drags him from love and happiness right to the edge of another dimension.

programme.title: Santosh (2024)
programme.desc: Newly widowed Santosh inherits her husband's job as a police constable. When a girl's body is found, she's pulled into the investigation under the wing of charismatic feminist inspector Sharma.

programme.title: She's Lost Control
programme.desc: The professional and personal life of a sexual surrogate begins to unravel when she starts working with a new client.

programme.title: Last Orders
programme.desc: A group of old friends reminisce about their lives over the years after the death of one of their crew.

programme.title: Irréprochable

programme.title: Every Thing Will Be Fine

programme.title: Don't Come Knocking

programme.title: Tale of Cinema
programme.desc: In Seoul, a suicidal student meets a young woman who decides to join him. An unsuccessful filmmaker, spots a beautiful young woman, who happens to be the lead actress in the film he has just seen.

programme.title: The Most Fun You Can Have Dying

programme.title: How He Fell in Love
programme.desc: A casual affair between a young musician and a married woman turns into an intimate and profound connection that threatens to derail their lives.
